left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Woman ≥ 18 years old
  -  undergoing laparoscopic surgery for endometriosis, [OR]  uterine myoma's, [OR]  hysterectomy  [OR] or colpopexy

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Women < 18 years old
  -  Males
  -  Pregnancy
  -  Conditions associated with chronic pain, such as peripheral neuropathy, [OR]  pathology  [OR] of the vertebral column and osteo-articular disease
